description: An inexpensive, bulky board pressed from straw fibre, chosen where economy matters. It is often laminated with a thinner facing board to build up the layered boards used in cheaper bindings.
name: strawboard

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter XIII, p.175. Internet Archive.
